P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor present on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract layout.

P05.rationale: The page contains no case studies with client portraits; the text blocks are generic content without specific named clients.

P07.rationale: A single statistic (58%) is presented as a data point rather than a social-proof apparatus like a press wall or review grid.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present in the form of large ghost numerals ('16') and massive headline text acting as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisation is present with a specific percentage (58%) clearly bound to a statement about B2B enterprises using autonomous systems.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text columns and large typography without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present in the form of a solid dark blue color field that provides high contrast for the white text.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability issues.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the imagery consists of abstract typography and a single statistic graphic.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks generic/stock rather than specific to a real business because it relies on abstract text blocks and a generic statistic rather than specific business photos.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is dense with two columns of text and large typographic elements filling most of the space.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo with no scrim because there are no photos present to create such an issue.
